description: Create a stored template, or replace the one with this slug. For bringing templates over from another provider: replace its merge tags with {{variable}} names (Mailchimp's *|FNAME|*, Kit's {{ subscriber.first_name }} and the like become {{first_name}}), and remove its unsubscribe link and footer, because SendRaven adds both to every marketing send. Values are HTML-escaped when the template renders. An existing slug is overwritten, so list_templates first when the slug might be taken.

slug.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; how sends refer to it

text.description: A plain-text body; left out, one is derived from the HTML

name: save_template
